cohort: This study included 621 patients with International Federation of Gynecology and Obstetrics stages I-III endometrial cancer undergoing robotic-assisted staging from January 1, 2009, through June 30, 2016.
finding: Introduction of sentinel lymph node biopsy reduces operative times and improves peri-operative surgical outcomes of robotic-assisted staging for apparent early-stage endometrial cancer without worsening the morbidity of hysterectomy alone.
